name: Bill Nelson
role: NASA Administrator (2021–2025)
quote: Artemis missions will send astronauts, including the first woman and first person of color, to explore more of the Moon than ever before. What we learn there will prepare us to send humans to Mars.

name: Jared Isaacman
role: NASA Administrator (2025–present) — Three priorities: Moon 2028, lunar base, commercial LEO
quote: I think it is NASA focusing on and achieving our near impossible mission that sends that powerful message of inspiration across the world. We will always follow the law at NASA.

name: Jim Bridenstine
role: NASA Administrator (2017–2021)
quote: Artemis is exceptional in the sense that unlike Apollo, today we have this very diverse and qualified astronaut corps. Our program reflects all of America, includes commercial partners and international partners.

name: Reid Wiseman
role: Artemis II Commander (NASA)
quote: We are going back to the Moon, and this time we're going to stay. The work we do on Artemis II will set the foundation for everything that comes after.

name: Victor Glover
role: Artemis II Pilot — First Person of Color on Lunar Trajectory
quote: Where we were in 1968, when humans first set out on this voyage, our country is in a very similar place now. And it's important to recognize and respect those skeptics.

name: Christina Koch
role: Artemis II Mission Specialist — First Woman on Lunar Trajectory
quote: When you look at the history of space exploration, there have been barriers that have kept people out. Artemis is about breaking those barriers — going farther together.

name: Jeremy Hansen
role: Artemis II Mission Specialist — First Non-American on Lunar Trajectory (CSA)
quote: Canada has contributed to every human spaceflight program since the Shuttle era. Flying to the Moon represents the next chapter for our country in space — and it belongs to all of humanity. Being welcomed home across Canada — Ottawa, CSA Headquarters, and finally Montreal — shows how deeply this mission touched people from coast to coast.

name: Mike Pence
role: U.S. Vice President (2017–2021) — Announced 2024 Moon Mandate
quote: We will return American astronauts to the Moon within the next five years. And this time, we will stay.

name: Elon Musk
role: SpaceX CEO — Starship HLS Prime Contractor
quote: Epic first Starship V3 launch & landing. The V3 heat shield held well. Ship 39 splashed down in the Indian Ocean as planned — humanity's multi-planetary future is getting very close. The boostback anomaly on Booster 19 will be investigated and fixed for Flight 13.

name: Gwynne Shotwell
role: SpaceX President & COO — HLS Operations Lead
quote: SpaceX is proud to be NASA's partner for the Human Landing System. Starship was designed for exactly this mission: landing people on other worlds and enabling a multi-planetary future.

name: Bob Smith
role: Blue Origin CEO (2017–2024) — National Team HLS Bid & Blue Moon Mk.2
quote: Only one HLS bidder was offered the opportunity to revise their price and funding profile, leading to their selection. Blue Origin was not offered the same opportunity. That was a mistake, it was unusual, and it was a missed opportunity.

name: Kathy Lueders
role: Former NASA Associate Administrator, Space Operations (2020–2023)
quote: How do we have the NASA mission be a multiplier? We do that by creating new connections — with commercial partners, with international partners, with the next generation of explorers.

name: John Honeycutt
role: NASA SLS Program Manager
quote: With a good flight cadence, SLS risk is 1 in 50. But with a multi-year gap between launches, that risk is probably closer to 1 in 2. Frequency matters enormously to maintaining the skills and processes that keep crews safe.

name: Jim Free
role: NASA Associate Administrator, Exploration Systems Development
quote: We may end up flying a different mission configuration if all elements are not ready. Safety drives our schedule — not politics. Every test result changes our understanding of what the vehicle needs.

name: Ted Cruz
role: U.S. Senator (R-TX) — Senate Space Commerce Champion
quote: America cannot cede the Moon to China. We must fund Artemis fully and ensure American astronauts plant the flag on the lunar south pole before any rival power establishes presence there.

name: Lisa Watson-Morgan
role: Former NASA HLS Program Manager (until 2025)
quote: The Human Landing System competition changed the paradigm of how NASA works with industry. We're not designing a vehicle — we're buying a transportation service that meets our requirements. That's a fundamentally different relationship.

name: Brian Babin
role: Chairman, House Science, Space & Technology Committee (R-TX)
quote: Tonight marks a historic achievement for the United States and a defining moment for the future of human space exploration. For the first time in more than 50 years, American astronauts traveled beyond low Earth orbit, returning to the Moon and showcasing the ingenuity, determination, and pioneering spirit that define our nation.

name: Jerry Moran
role: U.S. Senator (R-KS) — Senate CJS Appropriations Subcommittee Chair
quote: The $18.8 billion requested for NASA in FY2027 is not sufficient to continue NASA's current programs. This committee agrees that Artemis II was a tremendous success — but that success demands we properly fund the agency to build on it, not cut it.

name: Katie Britt
role: U.S. Senator (R-AL) — Senate CJS Subcommittee, NASA Budget Advocate
quote: Artemis II was a tremendous success that makes every American proud. We must continue to invest in nuclear thermal propulsion and the full range of NASA capabilities that will carry us to the Moon, and ultimately to Mars.

name: Lori Glaze
role: NASA Associate Administrator, Human Spaceflight Mission Directorate — Moon Base Program Lead
quote: The Moon Base contracts we're announcing today represent the most significant investment in permanent lunar surface infrastructure in the history of human spaceflight. Two competing crewed lunar terrain vehicles, a dedicated cargo delivery system, and reconnaissance drones — this is how we build to stay.

name: Mark Carney
role: Prime Minister of Canada — Hosted Artemis II Crew in Ottawa (May 13, 2026)
quote: Canada's contribution to Artemis II — with Jeremy Hansen as the first non-American beyond low Earth orbit since the Shuttle era — is a source of enormous national pride. Canada's partnership with NASA reflects our commitment to peaceful exploration and international cooperation in space.

name: Dave Limp
role: Blue Origin CEO — LC-36 Recovery & New Glenn Return-to-Flight
quote: We will return to flight before the end of 2026. The propellant farm is intact — a significant advantage. We've been developing an alternative vertical conops for some time and this is the path forward. We are focused on getting New Glenn back to the pad as quickly and safely as possible.

name: Mehdi Benna
role: LEMS Project Lead, NASA Goddard Space Flight Center
quote: Our vision was to create a scientific buoy for the Moon.
